exposure: oral health education (group discussion by dentists)
oral health education (face-to-face education by primary health care providers)
cohort: 439 pregnant women (mean age 27.47 years) from Varamin, Tehran, Iran, divided into intervention and control groups.
finding: Oral health educational interventions significantly increased daily brushing frequency and decreased the mean D (decayed teeth) component of DMFT among pregnant and lactating mothers.
